name: Pápakovácsi (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, light grey and green in the ratio 2:1:2, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pápakovácsi: a green shield with a white bend, a book and a ploughshare.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
